turns.text: it's 5:47 and i just woke up. i have 23 voicemails in the box and i need to clear it without listening to any of it. most are my mom, she calls around 1pm in vietnamese while i'm asleep. just the steps pls

Steps:
1. Turn on visual voicemail or voicemail transcription (phone settings > Phone/Voicemail > Transcription). Tell me your phone type if you can't find it.
2. Skim the transcripts by sender. Anything from your mom in Vietnamese may transcribe badly, so just check for urgent words.
3. Sort into three piles: urgent (a person in trouble, a deadline), needs a reply, and delete.
4. Reply to the urgent ones by text first.
5. Select all the rest and delete.
6. Send your mom one text so she knows to text instead.
